description: This is a Java interface file named EcuAddress.java that defines methods related to ECU address data handling for the RomRaider project.

classes.name: EcuAddress
classes.description: An interface defining methods to access ECU address information including address strings, byte arrays, bit position, and length.

methods.name: getAddresses
methods.description: Returns an array of address strings for the ECU.

methods.name: getBytes
methods.description: Returns a byte array representing the ECU address data.

methods.name: getBit
methods.description: Returns the bit position within the byte data.

methods.name: getLength
methods.description: Returns the length of the address data.
